backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, their files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of major frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS variables defining a warm, OKLCH-themed color palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point bootstrapping the app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Simple root component rendering the LandingPage.
Displays signed-in user's principal and provides a sign-out menu via dropdown.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Sticky header with logo, home navigation, and conditional auth controls using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Full authentication provider and hook handling Internet Identity login, logout, stored identity loading, and state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future custom React Query hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind styles defining warm fashion-themed color tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App bootstrap mounting React, wrapping it with InternetIdentityProvider and React Query.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the marketing landing page with a hero section, feature highlights, and calls to action, using React and Tailwind styling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and extended theme values for the app’s design system.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, existing features, requirements, and image needs for the Fashion Point application.
